To validate the ad impressions, use the following methods: to test your signature for view-through ads to test your signature for StoreKit-rendered ads to test your signature for web ads You need a cryptographic private key to generate signatures.
Use a public/private key pair that you create using an Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) with a prime256V1 curve.
